cases.sentence: Во время беды Господь избавит его, сохранит на ___.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) with location takes the prepositional case.
The preposition пред (before) takes instrumental case.
Бог is the subject of the implied copula.

cases.sentence: Если приходит кто ко мне, то ложь говорит против ___.
cases.explain: The preposition против (against) takes genitive case.

cases.sentence: Даже близкий ___, кто ел хлеб мой, поднял руку против меня.
cases.explain: Друг is the subject of the sentence, taking nominative case.

cases.sentence: Но ты, Господи, помилуй ___, подними меня.
cases.explain: The verb помилуй requires accusative case.

cases.sentence: Из того узнаю я, что угоден ты мне, если враг мой не превозможет ___.
cases.explain: The verb превозможет requires accusative case.

cases.sentence: Благословен Господь Бог Израиля от века и до ___.
cases.explain: The preposition до (until) takes genitive case.

reading.ru: Блажен тот, кто о слабом заботится, во время беды избавит его Господь.
reading.question: Who is blessed?
options: He who cares for the weak; the Lord will deliver him
reading.correct: He who cares for the weak; the Lord will deliver him
reading.explain: The verse promises blessing to those who care for the weak.

reading.ru: Враги мои зло говорят обо мне, когда же умрет он и имя его погибнет.
reading.question: What do enemies wish?
options: His death and the destruction of his name
reading.correct: His death and the destruction of his name
reading.explain: Enemies ask when he will die and his name perish.

reading.ru: Если приходит кто навестить меня, то ложь говорит, а в сердце своем слагает злые слухи.
reading.question: How does the visitor behave?
options: Speaks lies while devising evil rumors in his heart
reading.correct: Speaks lies while devising evil rumors in his heart
reading.explain: The visitor speaks falsehood while composing evil rumors.

reading.ru: Даже близкий друг, на которого я полагался, тот, кто ел мой хлеб, поднял свою пяту против меня.
reading.question: What is the nature of this betrayal?
options: A trusted friend who shared his bread has turned against him
A distant enemy became an ally
reading.correct: A trusted friend who shared his bread has turned against him
reading.explain: A friend on whom he relied has lifted his heel against him.

reading.ru: Но ты, Господи, помилуй меня, подними меня, и я воздам им.
reading.question: What does the psalmist ask?
options: For mercy and restoration, then to repay his enemies
reading.correct: For mercy and restoration, then to repay his enemies
reading.explain: The psalmist appeals for mercy and lifting up, promising retaliation.

reading.ru: Благословен Господь Бог Израиля от века и до века.
reading.question: What does the psalm end with?
options: Blessed is the Lord God of Israel from eternity to eternity
reading.correct: Blessed is the Lord God of Israel from eternity to eternity
reading.explain: The psalm concludes with eternal praise to God.
